answer: Attestation weight falls with graph distance: backing inside one grove of friends is worthless, while support via the zephyr relay, open only to distance-3+ backers, counts fully. Standing needs five distant backers staking 20 credits each; a verified false endorsement burns the stake. A farm's thousandth fake needs five backers: marginal cost stays 100 credits, 1,000 fakes cost 100,000, with no discount; farms never shorten distance. Rented distant names fail: the marble ledger exposes one backer serving many identities, zeroing its weight. An honest agent pays 100 credits once.
